author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
A living space simulation where the void is yours to wander, discover, and explore.

The StarSim: Beyond Space Creation introduces nearly 300 handcrafted orbits connected by physical gates, new explorable content, ships, weapons, and more.

See more info here: https://creations.bethesda.net/en/starfield/details/6218e01f-8e56-4a54-8eec-98774b66330f/StarSim__Beyond_Space
